caseNameFull: McCaughn, Director of Wharves v. Philadelphia Piers, Inc.
attorneys: Messrs. G. Coe Farrier and J. Harry LaBrum for petitioner., Messrs. Wm. A. Schnader, J. R. Guckes, and Windsor F. Cousins for respondents.
